title: Financial Services Administrator
description:
Brook Street Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with a highly regarded wealth management firm in Belfast City Centre to recruit an experienced Financial Services Administrator.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious and detail-oriented individual with a background in financial services administration, IFA support, wealth management, or investment administration to join a respected and growing organisation.

Working closely with Financial Planners and experienced support professionals, you will play a key role in delivering a first-class service to clients while supporting the smooth operation of the business.

The Role

As a Financial Services Administrator, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive administrative support to the wealth management team, ensuring all client-related processes are completed efficiently, accurately, and in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to Financial Planners and the wider wealth management team.
- Supporting new business processing and client onboarding activities.
- Preparing, processing, and submitting client applications.
- Maintaining accurate client records across CRM systems and internal databases.
- Processing transactions and instructions relating to investments, ISAs, pensions, and other financial products.
- Liaising effectively with clients, providers, and third-party organisations.
- Tracking and progressing outstanding documentation and applications.
- Preparing documentation and reports for client review meetings.
- Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and FCA regulatory requirements.
- Assisting with process improvement initiatives and learning new systems as required.

About You

To be considered for this opportunity, applicants should have previous experience within a financial services environment, ideally supporting Independent Financial Advisers (IFAs), Wealth Managers, or Financial Planners.

Essential Criteria
- Previous experience in Financial Services Administration, Wealth Management, Investment Administration, or IFA support.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Professional communication skills with a client-focused approach.
- Confident using CRM systems and processing detailed financial information.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively within a team.
- Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop.
- A genuine interest in advancing a career within the wealth management sector.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to join an established and highly respected wealth management firm.
- Exposure to experienced Financial Planners and industry professionals.
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
- Excellent prospects for career progression within financial services.
- Opportunity to develop specialist knowledge across investments, pensions, and private client wealth management.

If you have the relevant financial services administration experience and are looking to take the next step in your career please send your CV to Colleen Farquharson via the apply link

title: Contract Administrator
description:
Job Title: Contract Administrator
Location: Ballyclare, Northern Ireland
Salary: £27,000
Contract Type: Permanent, full-time
Working Hours: Full-time, Monday-Friday 9:00-17:00 but can be flexible

About the role

Join us as a Contract Administrator and you will get to play an integral part in the provision of high quality grounds services across your community. With strong communication and great organisational qualities, you will provide invaluable operations support to our 52 landscaping contracts, working across different client and internal portals.

Requirements
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Prior experience in an administrative role managing helpdesks
- Capable of dealing with a high workload and meeting deadlines
- IT literate with a strong working knowledge of excel and an ability to pick up new systems
- An eye for detail and problem solving capabilities
- Proficiency with basic Microsoft Office tools such as Excel.
- Some CRM experience preferable - training will be provided on portals.

As the UK's leading grounds maintenance and landscape creation provider, no two projects are ever the same - and neither are our people. That's why we're committed to nurturing a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

What we offer
- Career development: We offer career advancement and development opportunities through our bespoke apprenticeship programmes, our extensive in-house training academy, and coaching and mentorship.
- Collaborative team environment: Join a diverse and inclusive workplace where you can collaborate with passionate and talented individuals.
- Meaningful impact: Contribute to projects that make a real difference in the community and environment.
- Competitive benefits package: We recognise and reward your hard work with our wide ranging benefits package designed to prioritise your wellbeing, support life choices, and help in both good and challenging times.

Benefits
- Role-specific benefits: 21 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Family-friendly policies: Enhanced maternity and shared parental leave.
- Employee Assistance Programmes: Support for personal and professional challenges.
- Voluntary benefits: Discounts on retail, holidays, gym memberships, and more.
- Financial wellbeing support: Resources to manage your finances.
- Competitive pension scheme: Secure your future.
- Recognition schemes: Colleague of the month and annual awards.
- Volunteering policy: Two days per year to support a cause of your choice.
- Mental health support: Comprehensive resources and support.

About our client

We are Europe's largest provider of grounds maintenance services and landscape creation, in the UK alone we're a community of over 3,000 passionate colleagues shaping the future of the green industry.

We understand what it means to grow. Our history dates back to 1919, and today, with a turnover of £250 million, we're more than just a company - we're a force for positive change. We offer a range of services to create, maintain, and manage landscapes across the UK.

Grow with us, and together we'll create a greener future for all.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.
